mentions.name: claude-code-changelog-rss
mentions.description: An RSS feed service for the Claude Code changelog, built as a Cloudflare Worker. The repo is designed to work with any GitHub-hosted changelog file, turning it into an RSS feed so changelogs without feeds can be followed in RSS readers.
mentions.problem: The Claude Code changelog did not have an RSS feed, so it could not be added to an RSS reader.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I wanted to add the claude code changelog to my rss reader. 
It didn’t have a rss feed. Now it does. Had claude code built it: https://claude-code-changelog-rss.stevenmenke.workers.dev/feed.xml

Repo should work with any github hosted changelog file.
